# किसान साथी (Kisan Saathi) — फसल से लेकर बिक्री तक

> Kisan Saathi (किसान साथी) is a comprehensive Agritech Progressive Web App (PWA) and Android application designed for farmers in India, with specialized baseline intelligence for Chhattisgarh (IGKV Raipur, DAC&FW, Agmarknet).

## Core Farmer Resources & Modules

- [किसान साथी वेब पोर्टल (Kisan Saathi Web App)](https://kisan.init65.co.in/): All-in-one agricultural platform covering crop cycle, agro-climatic advisories, and procurement support.
- [एआई फसल डॉक्टर (AI Crop Doctor)](https://kisan.init65.co.in/?tab=doctor): Real-time multi-modal plant pathology diagnosis with statutory CIB&RC approved chemical remedies and organic solutions.
- [खाद व धान उपार्जन ₹3,100 कैलकुलेटर (Fertilizer & MSP Calculator)](https://kisan.init65.co.in/?tab=schemes): Exact NPK fertilizer dosage calculation and statutory Chhattisgarh Krishak Unnati Yojana paddy procurement and gunny bag estimator.
- [लाइव मंडी भाव (Live Mandi Rates)](https://kisan.init65.co.in/?tab=mandi): Real-time modal APMC market prices across all 33 districts of Chhattisgarh sourced from Agmarknet / OGD India.
- [किसान चौपाल (Kisan Chaupal)](https://kisan.init65.co.in/?tab=chaupal): Peer-to-peer farmer community, expert agricultural questions and answers, and custom hiring center equipment sharing.

## Documentation & Governance

- [किसान मार्गदर्शिका (User Manual)](https://kisan.init65.co.in/docs/USER_MANUAL.md): Comprehensive Hindi and Chhattisgarhi operational documentation for farmers and extension officers.
- [वर्शन व रिलीज़ जानकारी (Release Version)](https://kisan.init65.co.in/version.json): Official application release metadata and compatibility specifications.
- [एंड्रॉइड एपीके डाउनलोड (Android APK)](https://github.com/Paras65/kisansath-apk/releases/latest/download/kisan-saathi.apk): Official standalone APK package for offline installation.
- [हेल्पलाइन व संपर्क (Kisan Helpline)](tel:18001801551): 1800-180-1551 (टोल-फ्री किसान कॉल सेंटर).
